claims.statement: Percentage 1 produces measurable, center-weighted spreading, not a no-op: fresh-01 exports center RGB 41, adjacent values 25, and distance-two values 6 horizontally versus 5 vertically.

claims.scope: Supplied fresh-01 exported samples only; zero-valued samples do not establish exact kernel support.
unresolved: Exact kernel, support, separability, and cause of horizontal/vertical difference

claims.statement: Opaque inputs export reduced boundary alpha: fresh-01 has corner alpha 125 and midpoint-edge alpha 178; fresh-02 and gb017 have 82 and 145 respectively. Fresh-03 has corner alpha 72. Fresh-02 shows an inward impulse footprint and no visible RGB signal at the opposite midpoint.
claims.setup: Opaque impulses, opaque step edge, and prepared opaque RGB fixture.
claims.scope: Only supplied inputs at UI integers 1, 3, and 7; no claim for intervening settings or unsampled pixels.
alternatives: Blurred layer coverage or clipping in the render/export pipeline
unresolved: Exact padding, normalization, clipping, and filter-versus-export responsibility

claims.statement: Percentage 3 changes RGB and alpha samples. gb017 center changes from (255,235,140,255) to (187,179,152,255); gb010 center changes from (0,128,255,255) to (119,68,165,253). In fresh-04, alpha spreads across band boundaries while red remains 255 beside transparent black, including (255,65,14,55).
claims.setup: 129×97 opaque fixture, 65×49 transparent fixture, and 65×49 alpha bands.
claims.scope: Supplied exported RGBA samples; fresh-04 uses transparent black, half-alpha orange, and opaque blue bands, not hidden-color pixels.
unresolved: Hidden RGB at zero alpha, other partial-alpha colors, and internal representation

claims.statement: Alpha-weighted color processing followed by straight-RGBA export is a plausible explanation for retained color beside transparency; the internal mechanism is not established.

alternatives: Browser compositing or conversion producing equivalent samples
unresolved: Processing order, hidden-color handling, precision, and unpremultiplication

claims.statement: A smoothly center-weighted blur with greater effective spreading at higher settings is plausible: fresh-03 exports a rounded multi-pixel edge transition at Percentage 7, unlike fresh-01's narrow Percentage-1 impulse profile. Percentage remains a UI integer, not an established pixel radius or sigma.
claims.setup: 65×49 center impulse at 1 and opaque step edge at 7.
claims.scope: Comparison uses different diagnostics at settings 1 and 7; no matched-input scaling test or fitted formula.
unresolved: Exact kernel, radius/sigma mapping, dimension dependence, intermediate settings, and saturation

claims.statement: Exact rounding and quantization rules are unknown. Exported samples include horizontal/vertical differences in fresh-01 and substantial low-alpha RGB variation in fresh-04; these do not identify a rounding algorithm.
